title: Onondaga Camp

services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Onondaga Camp has welcomes schools and groups to explore the challenges and rewards of outdoor education. Located on the shores of Middle Bob Lake near Minden, Ontario, our Outdoor Education Centre offers adventure, learning, and fun in a supportive, natural setting. Participants can try a variety of activities while building confidence, teamwork, and new skills. Dates / Availability: Programs run from early May to late June and from September to Thanksgiving. We offer flexible programs that can be tailored to meet the needs of your school or organization.
